text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you,
we need more boom! More bang!
And umm… I want 
to do something that goes fast and makes a
nyoom sound!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Umm… We're still talking about the anniversary
live concert, right?
I can't imagine any of those onomatopoeias
having 
anything to do with it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
When you said "boom" and "bang…" you probably
mean that you 
want something with a huge impact.
And when it comes to "fast…"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I think that a float covered in lights 
would be likely to fit what she's
thinking.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahh… Umm, yeah,
Nature-san totes loves this 
"go with the flow" attitude that Ikuno
has!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha,
they seem to be having a lot of fun over there.
Okay, 
let's come up with some ideas of our own!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
O-Okay! Although, I don't think I'll 
have as many ideas as my senpais…!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We'll liven up the anniversary live
concert 
in our own way, so don't worry about it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yes, good! Such pure ambition!…Now then,
let's talk about 
which one of these party sunglasses we'll
be wearing!
